comment: Parity vectors for the native in-process embeddings backend (#1554 step 2). Reference outputs captured from the live :18752 sidecar (Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-m-v2.0, ONNX int8) on 2026-11-03 and re-verified bit-identical against the sidecar before being baked in. expectedBatch* are the sidecar responses to ONE call carrying all five texts (lengths 15/12/31/3/41 tokens); expectedSingle768 is texts[0] alone.
texts: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
query: what is the capital of France?
Embeddings turn text into vectors that capture semantic meaning, so similar sentences land close together in a high-dimensional space.
Snowflake Arctic Embed is a family of text embedding models optimized for retrieval workloads across many languages — 日本語のテキストも含まれます。
